description: Search the active USDA NRCS SNOTEL stations by state, name, county, minimum elevation or distance from a place (nearest first). Returns name, triplet (for the other tools), state, county, elevation, coordinates and the NRCS station page.

latitude.description: Latitude, with longitude, instead of location.

location.description: A place ("Breckenridge, CO", "Mount Hood", "Alta, UT"), a US ZIP code, or "lat, lon".

max_miles.description: Radius around the place in miles. Default 50.

min_elevation_ft.description: Only stations at or above this elevation in feet.

name.description: Part of a station name, such as "Pass" or "Summit".

name: snotel_stations
title: Find SNOTEL stations
